title: Chapter 199 The Central Region Of The Immortal Realm
content:
Chapter 199 The Central Region Of The Immortal Realm

"In the past few years, the power of taboo has been in your body and has never disappeared. All you can do is just suppress it. If it cannot be eradicated, you will never be able to make any progress in your life."

At this time, Lu Daosheng continued to say slowly.

As soon as these words came out, the old man looked at Lu Daosheng immediately, and a light flashed in his eyes.

"You, do you have a way?"

At this moment, Meng Tianyi was a little excited and nervous. The power of the taboo had eroded him for a long time. The pain of not being able to improve his cultivation made him, the powerful Immortal Emperor realm who was traversing the past, gradually lost his sharpness.

He is never the same as before.

And now, he saw hope here in Lu Daosheng.

"I can help you, as long as you serve me."

Looking at Meng Tianyi, Lu Daosheng said slowly.

Although this guy is not that amazing, it is still beneficial to have such a strong man in the deserted city of the Wood Fairy Realm now.

Therefore, Lu Daosheng extended an olive branch.

The advantage is to help him clear away the remaining taboo power in his body.

When Meng Tianyi heard Lu Daosheng's words, his expression suddenly lit up, but then he immediately became dim again.

After all, I am a strong man in the Immortal Emperor Realm. Even if I am a little unbearable now, it is still inappropriate to surrender to others so easily.

After a moment of silence, Meng Tianyi shook his head slightly.

"Sorry, I'm used to being idle alone."

Meng Tianyi refused Lu Daosheng's favor, which surprised Lu Daosheng slightly.

However, it is reasonable.

After all, Meng Tianyi is already in his twilight age. Even if the taboo power in his body is now cleared, Meng Tianyi probably doesn’t have much energy to continue practicing and break through.

Finally, Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun left here.

Meng Tianyi and Chen Chang'an watched them leave.

"Master, do you really matter?"

Chen Changan looked at Meng Tianyi with a weak expression, his eyes full of worry.

He used to know only what injury his master had suffered, so he retired to Qinglin Mountain.

Unexpectedly, my master was the terrifying crazy emperor when he fought back.

Although millions of years have passed, the legend of the Crazy Emperor was still circulated in the Wood Immortal Realm, but there are many versions. Some say that the Crazy Emperor wanted to destroy the Wood Immortal Realm, some say that the Crazy Emperor was framed, and some say that the Crazy Emperor was Have a strange treasure.

But without exception, no one denies the strength of the Crazy Emperor.

With one's own strength, he fought against the Nine Emperors alone.

Not to mention the Wood Immortal Realm, even the strong men in the Central Realm were shocked when they heard this.

At this time, Meng Tianyi shook his head.

"Disciple, Master, I will never do anything again in my life, but you are different, you still have a great future."

As he said that, Meng Tianyi looked at Chen Changan seriously.

"Next, it's time for you to go to the Central Region to explore."

Central Domain, the place that all practitioners in the fairy world yearn for.

The Central Domain, also known as the Immortal Domain, is a world filled with fairy spirit and rich resources.

There, there are countless opportunities and countless treasures of heaven and earth, and they also have fatal dangers. I don’t know how many powerful men and peerless geniuses have fallen in the central domain.

But even so, it still cannot stop the people in the fairy world from entering the central domain.

The immortal world is divided into five major immortal worlds.

They are the five immortal realms of gold, wood, water, fire, earth, and respectively.

Although the five immortal worlds are connected to each other, there is a barrier to the immortal world, blocking the connection between major immortal worlds.

Even the peak powerhouse in the Immortal Emperor Realm felt a little powerless when facing the barrier of the Immortal Realm.

The central domain is located in the center of the five great immortal realms. Although there are barriers to the immortal realm, it is much weaker than the barrier between the two realms. As long as you reach the Immortal Saint Realm, you can enter.

The powerful Immortal Emperor Realm is able to force people into it with great power.

Therefore, many powerful people in the five immortal worlds will use this method to force their descendants into the central domain for training.

Now, it is time for Chen Changan to enter the Central Region.

Hearing Meng Tianyi's words, Chen Changan nodded decisively without hesitation.

"Don't worry, Master, I will definitely not embarrass you."

"In a short time, my Chen Changan's name will resound throughout the Central Region!"

Afterwards, Meng Tianyi grabbed Chen Chang'an and headed directly towards the direction of the Central Region.

At the same time, at the boundary of the central domain.

Two figures slowly emerged.

"Is this the barrier to the Central Domain?"

Lu Daosheng murmured.

On the side, Yan Lingyun nodded.

"This is a barrier created to eliminate those who do not have the strength but still want to enter the Central Domain."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned, "What does it mean? Is this barrier caused by man?"

Yan Lingyun glanced at Lu Daosheng, then nodded and said, "When the immortal world was born, the entire immortal world was a complete continent without any obstacles."

"Until later, a change, the fairy world was broken into five pieces, and the spirits of the fairy world were divided into five."

Being broken.

Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

I have never understood this fairy world.

"Then what's going on in this Central Domain?"

Seeing that his wife seemed to know her very well, Lu Daosheng continued to ask.

"If I say that the Central Region fell from the sky, do you believe it?"

"I believe it."

Although Lu Daosheng was a little shocked, he still said decisively.

"That's right. The Central Region suddenly fell from the sky, and the powerful people in the fairy world at that time quickly discovered the mystery of this land that fell from the sky and took it for themselves."

Yan Lingyun was about to continue, but Lu Daosheng suddenly said: "They fought for this land, and the fairy world was broken like this?"

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun was slightly stunned, but then returned to normal.

"Yes, that's it."

The barrier between the five fairy worlds was transformed by the spirits of each fairy world.

After all, they have all developed their own spiritual intelligence, so they are no longer connected.

And the barrier of the Central Region was created by the victor at the time, in order to block the cultivators in the fairy world from the outside and enjoy it alone.

It has to be said that this is a very selfish behavior.

However, endless years have passed, and this barrier that blocks countless people in the fairy world still stands here.

Obviously, it is not so easy to break this rule.

Or perhaps, this rule has been tacitly accepted by the world.

"Lingyun, do you think this barrier should exist?"

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng suddenly asked.

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun's face was calm, "This is indeed very unfair to the creatures outside, but this is reality. The creatures that can live inside, which one is not exchanged for their own flesh and blood and strength by themselves or their ancestors."

"So it doesn't matter whether this barrier exists or not. If you want to come in, you have to rely on your own strength. Even if there is no barrier, even if you go in, you still can't survive in it without strength."
